author: Timur Isaev
title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided

scene.name: built-in benchmark
scene.commandLinePurpose: skip the launcher and intro videos; it does not select the benchmark
scene.deterministicPath: Main menu > Extras > Benchmark; title-owned fixed camera and workload sequence
scene.selectionVerification: Vision OCR finds EXTRAS and BENCHMARK; selected-row luminance must be at least 150 before Return
scene.startGate: title log reports Benchmark delay expired; starting statistics capture, paired with the latest completed DXMT Present
scene.endGate: title log reports Benchmark stopped, paired with the latest completed DXMT Present
scene.titleLogIsolation: Wine Documents is localized beneath the isolated prefix before title launch

graphics.unsupportedEightSampleRequest: logged and clamped to four samples

cachePair.cold: new empty shader-cache directory and freshly prepared isolated prefix
cachePair.warm: same shader-cache directory and persistent isolated wineserver

longSession.process: one exact DXMD.exe -benchmark host PID remains alive across benchmark-result and menu transitions
longSession.workload: repeat the OCR-verified built-in benchmark until the memory sampler completes
longSession.pidGuard: every sample verifies the original PID command contains DXMD.exe -benchmark; start.exe is rejected
longSession.cycleEvidence: each cycle has independent title-log occurrence baselines, DXMT marker bounds, and a scene summary

claimBoundary: The built-in benchmark is a repeatable representative scene, not a claim that every game path or quality setting is certified.
